title: 统计共同度过的日子数
summary: 给定两人在同一年内的到达与离开日期，统计两人同时在场的天数。
insight: 把 MM-DD 转换为非闰年年内序号，共同区间为较晚到达日至较早离开日，闭区间长度取非负。
pitfalls: 到达和离开日期都计入

solutions.title: 日期序号与闭区间交集
solutions.idea: 统一成整数轴求重叠长度。
steps: ordinal 累加此前月份天数再加 day

code.java: class Solution { private int day(String date){int[] days={31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31};int month=Integer.parseInt(date.substring(0,2)),value=Integer.parseInt(date.substring(3));for(int i=1;i<month;i++)value+=days[i-1];return value;}public int countDaysTogether(String arriveAlice,String leaveAlice,String arriveBob,String leaveBob){return Math.max(0,Math.min(day(leaveAlice),day(leaveBob))-Math.max(day(arriveAlice),day(arriveBob))+1);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun day(date:String):Int{val days=intArrayOf(31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31);val month=date.substring(0,2).toInt();var value=date.substring(3).toInt();for(i in 0 until month-1)value+=days[i];return value};fun countDaysTogether(arriveAlice:String,leaveAlice:String,arriveBob:String,leaveBob:String):Int{return maxOf(0,minOf(day(leaveAlice),day(leaveBob))-maxOf(day(arriveAlice),day(arriveBob))+1)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int day(string date){int days[]={31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31};int month=stoi(date.substr(0,2)),value=stoi(date.substr(3));for(int i=0;i<month-1;++i)value+=days[i];return value;}public:int countDaysTogether(string arriveAlice,string leaveAlice,string arriveBob,string leaveBob){return max(0,min(day(leaveAlice),day(leaveBob))-max(day(arriveAlice),day(arriveBob))+1);} };
